diagnostics.message: The EventBridge target can be installed before its Lambda invoke permission, allowing a scheduled invocation to fail during deployment. Make the target wait for the permission.
The scheduled scale-down target can become active before its Lambda invoke permission exists, so an invocation during deployment may fail. Make the target wait for the permission.
The pool EventBridge target can be created before the Lambda invoke permission, permitting a scheduled invocation to fail during deployment. Make the target wait for the permission.

The SQS event source mapping can become active before the scale-up execution role has its SQS permissions, which can cause polling or invocations to fail during deployment. Make the mapping wait for the role policy.

When Lambda VPC networking is enabled, the execution role needs the VPC access policy before the function is created/configured; the function only references its role, not this attachment. Order the function after the VPC execution-role attachment.
